scope: Six newly screened exact uses; proposed decisions for root integration, not direct shortlist changes

records.name: Topical ruxolitinib 1.5% cream for refractory Hailey-Hailey disease
records.exact_article: Ruxolitinib 1.5% cream; marketed Opzelura label defines 15 mg ruxolitinib/g cream
records.disease_genotype_scope: Hailey-Hailey disease associated with ATP2C1; no individual sequence-confirmed genotype established from the accessible single-case extraction
records.compartment_route: Local topical treatment of established intertriginous lesions
records.promotion_scope: Bounded controlled clinical proof; no S-tier or financeable proprietary-asset claim
records.evidence_stage: Human established-lesion improvement; uncontrolled case plus abstract-only preprint cohort

evidence_units.treatment_timing: Prior agents stopped; twice-daily ruxolitinib 1.5% cream to established disease
evidence_units.exposure: Nominal topical 1.5%; no disease-specific systemic exposure quantified here
evidence_units.comparator: Patient before treatment; no concurrent blinded control
evidence_units.useful_function: Rapid pain relief and reported resolution in three days; use became intermittent because of cost; remissions lasted weeks followed by milder flares; images at three months
limitations: Single uncontrolled patient
Relapsing disease and background-care confounding
Three-month images do not establish uninterrupted dosing or remission
No quantified mechanical barrier strength
Not permanent off-treatment cure
evidence_units.access: Root independently read full publisher case; this agent verified abstract, figure captions, and publisher indexing

evidence_units.unit: Patients reported in a preprint abstract
evidence_units.useful_function: Abstract reports re-epithelialization and reduced pain, itch, oozing and inflammation
evidence_units.access: Verified abstract only; full text and supplement not audited
limitations: Not peer reviewed
Exact genotype, regimen, background treatment and individual response denominators unverified
Overlap with case reports unresolved; do not sum counts into an independent cohort

availability.reconstruction: Existing labeled manufactured cream; independent reformulation has not been bridged
availability.sourcing_route: Current official marketed product label H3
availability.physical_lot: No received lot or stock confirmation
availability.model_readiness: Clinical lesion endpoints are directly relevant; controlled matched-lesion design remains proposed
availability.exposure_window: Other-disease label exposure does not establish absorption through eroded intertriginous HHD skin
availability.rights: A new developer's indication/formulation rights and differentiated contribution not established

current_programs.status: Enrollment complete at five patients; weekly dosing for 12 weeks ongoing; interim data expected before year-end
current_programs.supersession: Older anticipated enrollment of seven is not the current enrolled count

records.proposed_next_proof: Controlled matched-lesion test on stable documented background care; measure closure, lesion-free time, pain, rescue treatment, recurrence and local/systemic exposure
advance_if: Prespecified useful benefit over vehicle/background care across independent patients
Sustainable useful control with an acceptable measured exposure window
A differentiated clinical dataset, formulation/regimen or formal indication path is feasible
stop_if: No meaningful advantage in efficacy, tolerability, treatment burden or another intended product benefit over appropriate care
Effective exposure has an unacceptable local/systemic window
No substantive contribution beyond prescribing an existing cream for the proposed new-company thesis

records.promotion_scope: High human-value replacement/monitoring question; proprietary product thesis unestablished

evidence_units.comparator: Before/after; inadvertent discontinuation followed by relapse and reintroduction followed by improvement
evidence_units.useful_function: Gait, coordination and independence improved; baseline/nine-month video
limitations: Unblinded single patient
No controlled quantitative effect estimate
Cognitive improvement was subjective
Likely pathogenic variant not independently functionally validated in this extraction

evidence_units.useful_function: Motor, hearing and other neurological improvement with biochemical correction
limitations: Different MnSO4 dose convention
Do not add earlier diagnostic and later follow-up reports as independent cases
Primary abstract checked; complete genotype/formulation comparison not audited

evidence_units.useful_function: Abstract reports new motor milestones during oral manganese sulfate treatment
limitations: Exact formulation and dosing schedule not audited from full text
No quantitative pooled effect estimate

availability.sourcing_route: Specific trial-quality oral source not verified in this screen
availability.model_readiness: Clinical functional and biochemical monitoring route is published; prospective controlled execution not established

A practical clinical-research contribution beyond rediscovering replacement

Commodity replacement is presented as S-tier venture asset without differentiated product value

records.name: Nicotinamide for NAXE deficiency
records.exact_article: Nicotinamide, synonym niacinamide; distinct from nicotinic acid, nicotinamide riboside and NAXD combination therapy
records.disease_genotype_scope: NAXE-related encephalopathy; 2026 cohort enriched for p.Lys245Gln, with no all-variant efficacy claim
records.compartment_route: Oral NAD precursor support; functional neurological and respiratory outcomes
records.promotion_scope: Prospective functional clinical study; no proprietary asset claim
records.evidence_stage: Retrospective human cohort with functional improvements and a severe nonresponder

evidence_units.parent_cohort: Nine total: eight NAXE plus one NAXD; not nine treated NAXE
evidence_units.comparator: Retrospective prior state; no randomized contemporaneous control
evidence_units.useful_function: Five of six with reported ataxia/tone improvement at three to six months; median NAXE follow-up 3.76 years
evidence_units.negative: Patient 7 remained unconscious and continuously ventilated despite treatment; survival is not motor rescue
evidence_units.confounding: Four of six also received acute short-term vitamin cocktails, later stopped
evidence_units.tolerability: One patient reduced dose for flushing/perioral rash
lineage_limits: Pooled 59-case literature analysis is not 59 new independent patients
NAXD patient follow-up was previously published
NAXD biochemical work does not demonstrate NAXE drug response
Postmortem untreated diagnoses create selection and survival bias

evidence_units.article_identity: High-dose niacin in accessible abstract; exact dispensed species requires full-text identity audit before pooling as nicotinamide
evidence_units.useful_function: Initial transient stabilization followed by progression and death
evidence_units.access: Abstract and figure captions verified; full-text species not independently confirmed in this extraction

availability.reconstruction: Known small molecule; identity need not depend on author reply
availability.model_readiness: Published clinical functional endpoints; no ready NAXE neuronal drug-response assay established by the NAXD biochemical data
availability.rights: No demonstrated proprietary contribution or freedom-to-operate conclusion

records.proposed_next_proof: Prospective genotype/severity-stratified functional study recording exact vitamin species, timing and background care; outcomes include mobility, consciousness, respiratory dependence and episode burden
advance_if: Interpretable durable functional benefit beyond baseline severity and concurrent care
A concrete clinical-study or formulation contribution is established
stop_if: Universal reversal claim despite severe functional nonresponse
Vitamin B3 species treated as interchangeable

Specific clinical genotypes not recovered from verified abstract
Combined serum analytes do not establish free-parent therapeutic margin

One shared family is not multiple independent genotypes

records.name: ABX-1431 for AP4B1-SPG47 developmental functional rescue
records.exact_article: ABX-1431 = Lu AG06466 = elcubragistat; irreversible covalent MGLL inhibitor; MCE HY-117632, prepared in DMSO in the published study
records.compartment_route: Human iPSC-derived neuronal culture; systemic CNS treatment remains a development hypothesis
records.promotion_scope: Bounded functional-validation project; developmental outgrowth signal is not mature disease reversal

evidence_units.unit: Independent patient-derived iPSC backgrounds in drug outgrowth experiment
evidence_units.comparator: Unaffected sex-matched heterozygous parents, not isogenic corrected controls
evidence_units.treatment_timing: Day-six neurons replated and drug added; imaging begins four hours after plating then every three hours through 25 hours
evidence_units.exposure: 10/50 nM improved outgrowth; 100 nM partial; 500 nM ineffective
evidence_units.useful_function: Neurite length and branching; no demonstrated electrical connectivity or motor recovery
evidence_units.technical_units: Main panel 18 images from two biological replicates, not 18 donors
limitations: Third patient line used for other measurements is not a third drug-response donor
No established mature functional deficit before drug
No verified three-hour delayed drug start
Nonmonotonic dose-response
Morphology-only rescue

evidence_units.limitation: Not a drug-treated in-vivo motor rescue experiment

same_article_other_indication.finding: Twelve-week randomized trial did not establish tic efficacy; week-eight comparison favored placebo

Measured occupancy/exposure supports a plausible chronic window

No useful benefit at a plausible occupancy/tolerability window
